exercises.question: Which sentence identifies a place with a relative clause?
options: El barrio donde vivo es bastante tranquilo. [The neighbourhood where I live is quite quiet.]
El barrio está bastante tranquilo hoy. [The neighbourhood is quite quiet today.]
Vivo en el barrio desde hace un año. [I have lived in the neighbourhood for a year.]

exercises.sentence: Vivo en una vivienda __ está cerca del centro.
exercises.english: I live in a home that is near the centre.
The neighbourhood where I live is quite quiet.

sentences: Primero, vivo en una vivienda que está cerca del centro. [First, I live in a home that is near the centre.]

tener [to have]
